29	    into `OutgoingMessage`, where `ConversationSummary` is `SessionSummary` with its two times as

37	  non-locked path beside `ping` — a history request is not a turn and must not queue behind a

40	  a frame carrying an extra `userId` of another user is answered with the connecting user's own

- Opt-in: `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}`, default off, threaded through

  already authenticated, once per connection, by the consumer's own `wsAuth`.

  was already in; a list tells it what else the user has. A deployer who turned on resume did not

      retention note is mirrored on the new options type, pointing at #41

      regenerated with `npm run docs:fix`, not typed into the markdown

      match coverage, and `npm run check:spec-links`, `npm run check:spec-status` and

Three things changed between writing this issue and building it, each marked in the criterion it
affects:

1. **`before` is a cursor, not a timestamp.** #143's review found that paging on `updatedAt` alone

# Session Resume

| Field  | Value                |
| ------ | -------------------- |
| Issue  | re-cinq/HALEngine#45 |
| Status | Implemented          |

A reconnect used to resume nothing: the server minted a fresh id on every connection and never read the store, so a user whose socket dropped mid-conversation got an empty session and their next question reached the model with no context. Resume lets a reconnect name the session it had and rejoin it. - An upgrade outside `{basePath}/ws` carries no id ([validated by: reads nothing from an upgrade outside the base path](../../src/transport/ws/helpers.test.ts#L30)).
